notes: First correct fp32 NKI kernel for gqa_full (grouped-query full softmax attention, B1 N4096 QH16 KH8 D128, trn2). Per-head fusion: decomposes into a per-head bmm_softmax (scores + row-softmax over the key axis) followed by a context matmul. Per kh (8), build resident k_t[d=128, n_k=4096] via 32 identity-transpose subtiles (col offset 128*(4*a+b)) and v_sb[p=128, n_v=4096] with NO transpose (v native is already the moving layout), both reused across the 2 query groups (qh=2*kh+grp) and all 32 t_q. Per (grp,t_q): identity-transpose q -> q_t[d,m_q]; 8 single-pass D=128 matmuls build score[128,4096] in SBUF; full-width fp32 softmax epilogue reused from bmm_softmax_v4 + explicit 1/sqrt(128) scale (score*scale -> tensor_reduce(max,negate=True) -> activation(exp,bias=neg_max) -> tensor_reduce(add) -> reciprocal -> tensor_scalar(mul)); 32-step context matmul: per j=4*a+b transpose attn[:,128*j:+128] -> A_t, accumulate A_t.T@v_sb[:,128*j:+128] into a zero-init [128,128] PSUM bank over all 32 j (baseline's psum+=nc_matmul idiom), copy-store. Full 5-seed L2 PASS (correct 1/1) at 10.6579ms/1.462x over the 15.579ms baseline. on-device rel-L2=2.8743e-6 on ALL 5 seeds (~7x under the 2e-5 gate; between bmm_softmax_v4 2.57e-6 and the layout reconstruction 2.43e-7 -- clean fp32 emulation floor, no latent bug). MFU=16%% PE=48%% Vec=41%% Scl=42%% DMA=4%% HBMrd=67MB HBMwr=34MB. Traffic AT the read-once/write-once floor (HBMrd 67.2MB == q+k+v 33.55+16.78+16.78=67.1MB; HBMwr 33.6MB == output 16*4096*128*4=33.55MB; NO spill, DMA 3.9%%), confirming the baseline-spill fix (baseline materializes the whole QH*N*N score grid and round-trips it to HBM). PROMOTED (phase-1 correctness base / DAG root; no phase-1 perf floor).
